title: Adaptive LLM-Driven Honeypots vs. LLM-Driven Attackers: Does Narrative Coherence Improve Deception?
abstract: arXiv:2611.22589v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) enable honeypots to generate responses and deceptive artefacts on demand, yet existing approaches evaluate generated content one reply at a time and leave open whether artefacts that jointly describe a coherent event retain an attacker better than unrelated ones. This question becomes pressing as autonomous LLM-driven offensive agents emerge as realistic adversaries. This paper proposes narrative deception, a reactive strategy in which the defender maps each observed attacker command to a MITRE ATT&CK technique, selects a compatible scenario from a curated catalogue based on MITRE Engage, and deploys mutually referential artefacts (files, processes, services, and logs) on an emulated Ubuntu host while the intrusion is under way. translated_title: 自适应LLM驱动的蜜罐对决LLM驱动的攻击者：叙事连贯性能否提升欺骗效果？
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）使蜜罐能够按需生成响应和欺骗性制品，但现有方法一次只评估一条生成的回复，对于共同描述一个连贯事件的制品是否比互不相关的制品更能留住攻击者，这一问题尚无答案。随着自主的LLM驱动的攻击代理成为现实对手，这个问题变得日益紧迫。本文提出了“叙事欺骗”这一反应式策略：防御者将观察到的每条攻击者命令映射到MITRE ATT&CK技术，从基于MITRE Engage整理的场景目录中选择兼容的场景，并在入侵进行过程中在模拟的Ubuntu主机上部署相互引用关联的制品（文件、进程、服务和日志）。一个由LLM驱动的防御者与一个自主的LLM攻击者通过真实的SSH会话进行交互，攻击者的终止策略可用于区分因怀疑遭遇欺骗而放弃入侵的情况。
tldr: 本文提出“叙事欺骗”反应式策略，通过将攻击者命令映射到MITRE ATT&CK技术并部署相互关联的连贯欺骗场景，探索叙事连贯性是否能比不相关内容更有效地留住LLM驱动的自主攻击者。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "narrative deception," a reactive strategy that maps attacker commands to MITRE ATT&CK techniques and deploys mutually referential artifacts, investigating whether narrative coherence improves honeypot retention of autonomous LLM-driven attackers.
